caveat: A PROXY for detector box noise, not ground truth. The residual is measured against a median-filtered version of the track's own trajectory, so the filter's smoothing, any identity error in the association, and genuine sub-filter motion are all part of what is reported here. Treat it as the scale of the jitter, not as a measurement of the detector.
association: GreedyIoUTracker, whose Track.box is the last OBSERVED detection box; the engine's tracker would report its own Kalman-smoothed boxes instead.
